description:
Framework-agnostic Pathland UI toolkit: declarative view DSL (dev.pathland.view),
        Angular-style signals/computed/effects (dev.pathland.view.signal), a fine-grained
        opcode emitter (dev.pathland.view.emit), the wire codec (dev.pathland.view.transport),
        lazy JNA ring interop (dev.pathland.view.ffm), and cross-platform state
        (dev.pathland.view.state). Runs on every LTS from Java 17; JNA is the only
        runtime dependency.
